  skip_global_opts routine, replacing the three per-site regexes that each
  separately enumerated git global-option shapes. This closes the six

  checks BOTH payload cwd and resolved -C/cd scope (deny if either is

  explicitly unset, so stdout carries only the JSON decision. The header
  states the narrowed contract, the word-boundary rule, and a named list
  of out-of-scope lexical forms.

  allow, exactly one deny line for deny) rather than a substring match.

  make check clean on every commit (six total: scanner + ref-check
  fixes, new test coverage, header/CDPATH polish + CHANGELOG, push-flag
  value fix, quote-boundary fix, CHANGELOG extension).
